spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Per time bucket: true when the signal was true at any moment in that bucket.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  max(deck_slide_wind_drive_fail__value) AS "Owners Deckh. Sliding Window Sys. - Drive Failure",
  max(w_tight_hatch_rm_35_commonalarm__value) AS "Weather Tight Hatch RM-35 - Common Alarm",
  max(w_tight_hatch_rm_36_commonalarm__value) AS "Weather Tight Hatch RM-36 - Common Alarm",
  max(wtsd_mainbackuppwrfail__value) AS "WTSD Main/Backup - Power Failure",
  max(sos_lock_supply_14_e_11_fail__value) AS "SOS Locker Supply 14E1-1 - Failure",
  max(sos_lock_supply_14_e_12_fail__value) AS "SOS Locker Supply 14E1-2 - Failure",
  max(sos_lock_supply_14_e_13_fail__value) AS "SOS Locker Supply 14E1-3 - Failure",
  max(haz_consumers_emergstopactive__value) AS "Emergency Stop Haz. Cons. - Active"
FROM marpower__090000_doors_hatches
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) 
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message.

spec.rawSql:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT * FROM marpower__090000_doors_hatches
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN CASE l.deck_slide_wind_drive_fail__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 2 THEN CASE l.w_tight_hatch_rm_35_commonalarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 3 THEN CASE l.w_tight_hatch_rm_36_commonalarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 4 THEN CASE l.wtsd_mainbackuppwrfail__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 5 THEN CASE l.sos_lock_supply_14_e_11_fail__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 6 THEN CASE l.sos_lock_supply_14_e_12_fail__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 7 THEN CASE l.sos_lock_supply_14_e_13_fail__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 8 THEN CASE l.haz_consumers_emergstopactive__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(l.timestamp) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Owners Deckh. Sliding Window Sys. - Drive Failure', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Weather Tight Hatch RM-35 - Common Alarm', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (3, 'Weather Tight Hatch RM-36 - Common Alarm', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (4, 'WTSD Main/Backup - Power Failure', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (5, 'SOS Locker Supply 14E1-1 - Failure', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (6, 'SOS Locker Supply 14E1-2 - Failure', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (7, 'SOS Locker Supply 14E1-3 - Failure', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (8, 'Emergency Stop Haz. Cons. - Active', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN l ON true
ORDER BY s.n

spec.rawSql:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT * FROM marpower__090000_doors_hatches
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
m AS (
  SELECT mqtt_json_path, max(yard_tag) AS yard_tag FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
  WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/090000-doors-hatches' GROUP BY mqtt_json_path
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  coalesce(m.yard_tag, s.tag) AS "Tag",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN CASE l.laza_access_hatch_sb_fwd_closed__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 2 THEN CASE l.laza_access_hatch_ps_fwd_closed__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END

    WHEN 11 THEN CASE l.platfrom_closed_locked__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 12 THEN CASE l.dinghy_stor_acc_fwd_closed__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 13 THEN CASE l.hatch_chainlocker_sensor_1_closed__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 14 THEN CASE l.hatch_chainlocker_sensor_2_closed__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 15 THEN CASE l.all_hull_valves_close__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 16 THEN CASE l.wtsd_doorclose__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 17 THEN CASE l.wtsd_dooropened__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END

spec.name: live_window
spec.description: How far back the Live tabs look for the latest message, independent of the time picker. The Live tables' no-data text ('No data in the last 5 minutes') repeats this value.
